## Introduction

This appendix documents the User Roles defined for [Application] — the set of roles a user or system account may be granted, and what each role is permitted to do. Reference *SDP\_[Application]\_Appendix\_T\_Security\_and\_Auditing.docx* for how these roles are assigned (identity provider, group mapping, provisioning process).
